svg.aria-label: Category cards on a phone: a drag of 220 px to the right likes Cultural, a drag to the left passes Shopping, two more likes make three, and Hanepyon says Great choice

g.text: Over 30 px right is a like.
Over 30 px left is a pass.
Over 30 px right is a like.
Over 30 px left is a pass.
Over 30 px right is a like.
Over 30 px left is a pass.
The card leaves to the right,
and the next card waits below.
The card leaves to the right,
and the next card waits below.
The card leaves to the right,
and the next card waits below.
A pass leaves to the left.
A pass leaves to the left.
One more like ends the round.
One more like ends the round.
